cohort: A single patient who developed pubic symphysis septic arthritis due to Cutibacterium acnes after caesarean delivery.
finding: A rare case of pubic symphysis septic arthritis caused by Cutibacterium acnes after caesarean section presented with chronic pain and pelvic girdle destabilization, requiring extensive treatment and leading to a prolonged diagnostic process.
mod_finding: The reported case of pubic symphysis septic arthritis occurred after delivery by caesarean section.
